name: mallok
description: Open-source, Cloudflare-native content website. Markdown in D1, instant publishing, no build step.
author: FobStack

scripts.build: pnpm run build:themes && pnpm run build:admin && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:themes && pnpm run build:admin && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && node scripts/ensure-secret.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/runtime/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/runtime/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/admin/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: biome check . && cd template && biome check .
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && cd template && biome check --write .
scripts.test: vitest run --project core --project worker --project worker-setup-key --project worker-unclaimable --project runtime --project runtime-workerd --project runtime-dom --project runtime-build
scripts.build:site: pnpm run build:package && node dist/pkg/cli/index.js build . --theme ./src/themes/atelier --out dist/site
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --project core --project runtime --project runtime-dom --project runtime-build --coverage

MALLOK_SECRET.description: Required. Signs sessions and encrypts plugin API keys. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep it — changing it signs everyone out and makes stored plugin keys unreadable.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. A Cloudflare API token with **Zone → Cache Purge → Purge**, scoped to this site’s zone. Without it the site works, but an edit becomes visible when the cached page expires rather than immediately.

CF_ZONE_ID.description: Optional, and only useful together with `CF_API_TOKEN`. The Zone ID shown on your domain’s overview page in the Cloudflare dashboard.
